mentions.name: OpenChessClub
mentions.description: Open-source, free chess club management software that records members and games and assigns a local club rating. Planned features include a QR code generator for member check-in during meetings and automatic player matching. Primarily aimed at smaller chess clubs.
mentions.problem: The author started a local chess club and could only find paid software for managing it, with no open-source/free options for recording members, games, and club ratings.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted something that would allow us to record members, games, etc., and also allow us to be assigned a local club rating. Anyway, after doing some searching and only finding paid software, I decided to just build something. That lead to https://openchessclub.org
